name: Architectural Design
description: Jurisdiction, code pack, export and rendering defaults for the Architectural Design toolkit.

settings.label: Default region
settings.description: Jurisdiction used for compliance dispatch, wind and seismic tables, BoQ format, currency and cost rates.

settings.label: Default unit system
settings.description: Measurement system for floor plans, dimensions, loads and area calculations.

settings.label: Building code pack
settings.description: Primary code pack for compliance validation. Custom packs register through the wp_mcp_ai_arch_code_packs filter.

settings.label: Default export format
settings.description: Format for exporting architectural documents and BIM models.

settings.label: IFC export version
settings.description: Schema version used by the IFC STEP-format builder.

settings.label: Rendering quality
settings.description: Default quality for 3D renderings and visualisations.

settings.label: Enable GPU rendering
settings.description: GPU acceleration for rendering; requires remote sites.

settings.label: Sustainability framework
settings.description: Framework used by the EDGE and LEED v4 certification scorers. EDGE is the default for LK and JM, LEED v4 BD+C for the US.

settings.label: BoQ MasterFormat year
settings.description: MasterFormat edition used when generating bills of quantities.
